title: Exact 3D subobject, parameter and free-section correction invariants

rules.requirement: Every subobject operation must bind to the current plan source SHA-256 and an exact feature_id|semantic_subobject reference.
rules.failure_mode: A stale view can otherwise edit a different topology after rebuild.

rules.requirement: Every view carrying the same reference_key must expose identical edit paths, edit scope, shared groups, affected count, preserve-policy flag, and detach support.
rules.failure_mode: A projection may otherwise authorize broader edits than the native semantic selector.

rules.requirement: Moving a parameterized rectangle boundary must declare keep_center, keep_opposite, or keep_size; moving an extrusion end plane must declare keep_support.
rules.failure_mode: An edge move is underdetermined without an explicit invariant to preserve.

rules.requirement: A shared pattern instance may change only through scope=shared_parameter_group with the exact current affected instance count and shared parameter groups.
rules.failure_mode: Editing one visible hole can silently change every pattern member or detach one instance.

rules.requirement: Every candidate must recompile the complete ordered feature graph and report direct, downstream affected, and preserved objects.
rules.failure_mode: A locally valid change can invalidate containment, support, volume, or later features.

rules.requirement: The global datum feature must remain origin anchored after every boundary correction.
rules.failure_mode: Keeping one opposite edge can translate the base and destroy the coordinate datum.

rules.requirement: A cut supported by a circular boss must retain positive radial wall greater than the plan tolerance.
rules.failure_mode: Equal-radius or offset corrections can mathematically compile while removing the functional boss.

rules.requirement: A relation already satisfied by the profile parameterization must be audited as already_satisfied with no changed paths.
rules.failure_mode: Fake changes obscure review scope and can create meaningless int-to-float diffs.

rules.requirement: Plan-derived exact references must never be represented as native CAD persistent topology authority.
rules.failure_mode: Semantic edge labels do not prove that SolidWorks or AutoCAD persisted the same BREP subentity after rebuild.

rules.requirement: The review UI must preserve UTF-8 Chinese, thin precision strokes, independent hit tolerance, no horizontal overflow, and a browser-verified formal transaction draft.
rules.failure_mode: Code-page corruption or oversized JSON can make the correction interface unreadable even when geometry is valid.

rules.requirement: The user-facing reviewer must expose one modification list; natural-language instructions and direct numeric edits may differ internally but must not require two user workflows.
rules.failure_mode: Exposing candidate intent and executable transaction as separate primary flows creates duplicate controls and avoidable technical burden.

rules.requirement: Every 3D reviewer must accept a finite nonzero plane normal plus a finite point, with axis equations treated only as shortcuts, and calculate sections from compiled feature operations rather than pixels.
rules.failure_mode: A fixed X=0/Y=0 view catalog cannot inspect arbitrary internal structure and image-derived sections have no dimensional authority.

rules.requirement: Centers, axes, pitch circles and interface edges must have stable semantic references, remain hidden by default, reveal on hover/focus, and be independently selectable.
rules.failure_mode: Always-visible construction geometry clutters the drawing, while absent hit geometry makes critical relations impossible to select.

rules.requirement: The right panel must derive and display every independent core parameter from the compiled feature and clicking a value must select its exact controller and prefill the editor.
rules.failure_mode: A raw parameter-path dropdown hides important dimensions and allows feature parameters to be omitted from review.

rules.requirement: Release QA must exercise hidden-geometry hover, parameter prefill/edit, axis and oblique sections, section selection, point relations, UTF-8, overflow and review locks in a real browser.
rules.failure_mode: Static HTML inspection cannot prove pointer hit testing, canvas section interaction or responsive layout.

rules.requirement: Every selectable line, point, circle and face must carry a typed measurement derived from the compiled model coordinate system: line length and endpoints, point XYZ, circle center/radius/diameter, or face area; projection-only values must be explicitly labeled and screen pixels are forbidden as dimension authority.
rules.failure_mode: A parameter catalog can exist while the selected object still shows no direct value, and projected pixels can be mistaken for model dimensions.

rules.requirement: Every review view must expose the right-handed MODEL_XYZ datum and a single visible switch must hide or restore SVG axes, origin markers and the rotating 3D XYZ triad together.
rules.failure_mode: Coordinates are ambiguous without a visible datum, while an always-on coordinate overlay can obstruct detailed geometry review.
